contexts: 38 percent attend two thirds of sessions
reading: Attendance falls after week six for reasons outside the classes: transport, pain, difficulty level and broken habits. Reminders and calls after missed weeks target the broken habit (c1); peer calls target home exercise (c2); neither has been shown to prevent falls at this scale (c3). Class registers already record attendance, which keeps the trial inside usual practice.
